H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H7141: Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites
H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H4908: a residence (including a shepherd's hut, the lair of animals, figuratively, the grave; also the Temple); specifically, the Tabernacle (properly, its wooden walls)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H6635: a mass of persons (or figuratively, things), especially reg. organized forwar (an army); by implication, a campaign, literally or figuratively (specifically, hardship, worship)
H3700: properly, to become pale, i.e. (by implication) to pine after; also to fear
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H3615: to end, whether intransitive (to cease, be finished, perish) or transitived (to complete, prepare, consume)
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H2691: a yard (as inclosed by a fence); also a hamlet (as similarly surrounded with walls)
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H1320: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman
H7442: properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H410: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H4672: properly, to come forth to, i.e. appear or exist; transitively, to attain, i.e. find or acquire; figuratively, to occur, meet or be present
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H1866: the swift, a kind of swallow
H7064: a nest (as fixed), sometimes including the nestlings; figuratively, a chamber or dwelling
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H7896: to place (in a very wide application)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H835: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H5750: properly, iteration or continuance; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), again, repeatedly, still, more
H1984: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stultify
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H4546: a thoroughfare (as turnpiked), literally or figuratively; specifically a viaduct, a staircase
H3824: the heart (as the most interior organ);
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H4599: a fountain (also collectively), figuratively, a source (of satisfaction)
H5844: to wrap, i.e. cover, veil, cloth, or roll
H4175: an archer; also teacher or teaching; also the early rain
H3212: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)
H2428: probably a force, whether of men, means or other resources; an army, wealth, virtue, valor, strength
H7200: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
H6726: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H8605: intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn
H238: to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen
H4043: a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile
H5027: to scan, i.e. look intently at; by implication, to regard with pleasure, favor or care
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H4899: anointed; usually a consecrated person (as a king, priest, or saint); specifically, the Messiah
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H2896: good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well)
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H505: hence (the ox's head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a thousand
H977: properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select
H1752: properly, to gyrate (or move in a circle), i.e. to remain
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H8121: the sun; by implication, the east; figuratively, a ray, i.e. (architectural) a notched battlement
H2580: graciousness, i.e. subjective (kindness, favor) or objective (beauty)
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H4513: to debar (negatively or positively) from benefit or injury
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H8549: entire (literally, figuratively or morally); also (as noun) integrity, truth
H982: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
